$comment: Cross sections in nanobarn for proton–proton collisions, tabulated against √s in GeV. Values are σ × branching ratio into the listed final state, integrated over all rapidity; the detector model applies the acceptance. Several entries are order-of-magnitude parametrisations for the game and are marked as such. Final states: mumu (μ⁺μ⁻), gammagamma (γγ), fourlepton (ℓ⁺ℓ⁻ℓ⁺ℓ⁻ via ZZ*).

processes.source: ALICE, Eur. Phys. J. C 73 (2013) 2456, arXiv:1208.4968 (0.9, 2.76, 7 TeV); TOTEM, Eur. Phys. J. C 79 (2019) 103, arXiv:1712.06153 (13 TeV). Intermediate points interpolated.

Order of magnitude from inclusive J/ψ measurements: ALICE, Eur. Phys. J. C 77 (2017) 392, arXiv:1702.00557 (13 TeV midrapidity); LHCb, JHEP 10 (2015) 172, arXiv:1509.00771 (13 TeV forward). Extrapolated to full rapidity and multiplied by BR(J/ψ→μμ) = 5.96 %. Simplification: ±50 %.
Order of magnitude from CMS, Phys. Lett. B 749 (2015) 14, arXiv:1501.07750 (7 TeV) and LHCb, JHEP 07 (2018) 134, arXiv:1804.09214 (13 TeV), extrapolated to full rapidity. Simplification: ±50 %.
Ratio Υ(2S)/Υ(1S) ≈ 0.27 from CMS arXiv:1501.07750, applied to the Υ(1S) row.
Ratio Υ(3S)/Υ(1S) ≈ 0.13 from CMS arXiv:1501.07750, applied to the Υ(1S) row.

ATLAS, Phys. Lett. B 759 (2016) 601, arXiv:1603.09222 (13 TeV: σ·BR(Z→ℓℓ) = 1.98 nb); ATLAS, Eur. Phys. J. C 77 (2017) 367, arXiv:1612.03016 (7 TeV: 0.99 nb). Other points interpolated with the parton-luminosity trend.

Game parametrisation of the smooth dimuon background (Drell–Yan γ* and combinatorial pairs from heavy-flavour decays) as a single power law dσ/dm ∝ m^-3.5. Normalised so that signal-to-background is about 3 at the J/ψ and about 10 at the Z, consistent in order of magnitude with the published CMS and ATLAS dimuon spectra. Physics: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Drell%E2%80%93Yan_process

Total Higgs production (ggF + VBF + VH + ttH) from the LHC Higgs Cross Section Working Group, https://twiki.cern.ch/twiki/bin/view/LHCPhysics/LHCHXSWG: 17.5 pb at 7 TeV, 22.3 pb at 8 TeV, 55 pb at 13 TeV; multiplied by BR(H→γγ) = 0.227 % (PDG 2024). Points below 7 TeV extrapolated.

Game parametrisation of the diphoton background (prompt γγ, γ+jet and jet–jet fakes) as dσ/dm ∝ m^-4, normalised to roughly 250 events per GeV per fb⁻¹ at 125 GeV after selection at 13 TeV, in line with the ATLAS and CMS H→γγ spectra (ATLAS, Phys. Lett. B 716 (2012) 1, arXiv:1207.7214; ATLAS, Phys. Rev. D 98 (2018) 052005, arXiv:1802.04146).
Total Higgs production from the LHC Higgs Cross Section Working Group multiplied by BR(H→ZZ*→4ℓ, ℓ = e, μ) = 1.25·10⁻⁴ (PDG 2024): 6.9 fb at 13 TeV.
Order of magnitude for Z→4ℓ (Z→ℓℓγ*→4ℓ): the Z row scaled by BR(Z→4ℓ)/BR(Z→μμ) with BR(Z→4ℓ) ≈ 4.5·10⁻⁶ per lepton combination (CMS, JHEP 12 (2012) 034, arXiv:1210.3844). Simplification: ±50 %.

Game parametrisation of the non-resonant ZZ*→4ℓ background as dσ/dm ∝ m^-1.2 on 100–500 GeV, normalised so that the signal-to-background ratio in the Higgs window is about 1.5, as in ATLAS, JHEP 10 (2017) 132, arXiv:1708.02810. The real spectrum has a step at 2·m_Z that this shape ignores.

High-mass Drell–Yan above the Z: σ(m > 120 GeV, →μμ) ≈ 10 pb at 13 TeV with dσ/dm ∝ m^-4.5, in line with ATLAS, JHEP 08 (2016) 009, arXiv:1606.01736 (8 TeV) and the dilepton spectra of ATLAS, Phys. Lett. B 796 (2019) 68, arXiv:1903.06248 (13 TeV). Game parametrisation, ±50 %.
